name: megascenes-valentine-wallpaper
description: Create Valentine's Day wallpapers for your phone or computer: hearts, roses, soft pink skies and candlelight, in the style you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the Valentine's scene you want behind your apps: floating pink hearts over a sunset sky, red roses on dark velvet, cozy candlelight, a minimal pattern of little hearts, as a photo, watercolor, minimal flat, cute cartoon or dreamy pastel. You get a wallpaper in the shape you need, tall for a phone or wide for a computer, with a calm area at the top for the clock.

ChatGPT tells you what the wallpaper needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For phones, laptops, lock screens and matching wallpapers for the two of you.

Limitations: one image per run, without text; it does not set the wallpaper on your device for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Tall for phones or wide for computers
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Valentine phone wallpaper of floating pink hearts over a sunset sky
Red roses on dark velvet as a wide desktop background
A minimal pattern of little red hearts on blush pink for my phone

positive.prompt: A Valentine phone wallpaper of floating pink hearts over a sunset sky. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one wallpaper needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Red roses on dark velvet as a wide Valentine desktop background. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one background needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a Valentine wallpaper here?
positive.expected_behavior: The wallpaper models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A Valentine wallpaper of cozy candlelight and rose petals in dreamy pastel, tall for my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my wallpaper on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my wallpaper to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
